hints.title: Leaf Boundary
hints.text: Leaves form a cycle, meaning their child pointers do not indicate deeper subtrees.

hints.title: Detecting Leaf Nodes
hints.text: A node is a leaf in this representation if its left child has a right pointer referencing the node itself.

hints.title: Height Aggregation
hints.text: If a node is recognized as a leaf, return 0; otherwise return 1 plus the maximum child height.

hints.title: Implementation

variables: n: number of nodes in tree
complexity.notes: Cycle-aware depth-first traversal identifying circular leaf links.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Standard traversal without cycle detection will recurse infinitely through circular pointers.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) time visiting each node once and O(h) call stack memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identify the structural invariant that characterises leaf nodes in the modified tree.
